title: CAD/CAM Deep AGI System — Full Neural Drawing + Intelligent CAM Orchestration
brief: Build near-AGI CAD/CAM system. CAD side: neural drawing synthesis that LEARNS how to draw in any CAD software (FreeCAD/CadQuery/Fusion360/Mastercam/Inventor/hyperMILL/SolidCAM) to produce 100% accurate complex models with tons of features. CAM side: intelligent optimal toolpath selection for any moment, fully optimized CNC programs. Training corpus: 24,545 JM Die programs + 100+ customer databases + 3,700+ tribal tips.
authority: User directive 2026-04-18: full AGI capability for CAD/CAM

sub_milestones.title: CAD Neural Drawing Foundation — Deep Learning CAD Synthesis
sub_milestones.intent: Build neural network-based CAD generation that synthesizes parametric CAD models from natural language / print descriptions. Core ML pipeline with training on JM Die corpus.

sub_milestones.title: CAD Software Action Learning — Per-Software Drawing Intelligence
sub_milestones.intent: Teach the AGI HOW to draw in each CAD software (CadQuery/FreeCAD/Fusion360/Mastercam/Inventor/hyperMILL/SolidCAM). Action sequence learning — click-by-click reproduction.

sub_milestones.title: Complex Feature Synthesis — Advanced CAD Model Generation
sub_milestones.intent: Generate highly advanced CAD models with complex features: multi-body assemblies, sweeps, lofts, patterns, configurations, iLogic rules, parametric drivers.

sub_milestones.title: CAD Accuracy Validation — 100% Accurate Guarantee
sub_milestones.intent: Validate every generated CAD model is 100% accurate: dimensional, topological, manufacturability, tolerance stack. Rebuild until perfect.

sub_milestones.title: CAM AGI Orchestrator — Optimal Toolpath For Any Moment
sub_milestones.intent: Intelligent CAM programming that selects optimal toolpath strategy for each feature at each moment. Beats human programmers by synthesizing 18-CAM knowledge + tribal tips + physics.

sub_milestones.title: Adaptive Execution System — LOC-Driven Parameters
sub_milestones.intent: Real-time parameter adjustment as LOC/engagement changes. RPM, feed, stepover auto-adjust on 3D adaptive roughing. Ever-evolving cutting conditions handled.

sub_milestones.title: MasterPostProcessor AGI Enhancement — Cost-Efficient G-Code
sub_milestones.intent: Enhance existing MasterPostProcessorAGIOrchestrationEngine. Full machine exploitation, controller-specific canned cycles, G-code compression, cycle time optimization.

sub_milestones.title: E2E Pipeline Integration — Print-to-Shipped AGI
sub_milestones.intent: Full integration: print/description → CAD model → CAM program → optimized G-code → JM Die production. Integration testing with 24,545 JM Die programs as regression corpus.

cad_ai_gap.current_state: NO CAD generation AI exists. All existing AI is CAM-side (248 engines) and physics (17 engines).
cad_ai_gap.impact: Without CAD AI, system cannot generate models — forces human CAD drawing

cam_ai_gap.current_state: Strong CAM AI foundation (CAMDeepLearningEngine, 18 CAM systems) but no unified AGI orchestrator for optimal-at-every-moment decisions.
cam_ai_gap.impact: Without CAM AGI, system uses static strategies — suboptimal

formulas: Kienzle cutting force (Fc = kc1_1 * ap * fz^(1-mc))
ml_foundations: Graph neural networks for CAD topology

FreeCAD model → hyperMILL 5-axis (free CAD + premium CAM)
